basic.description:
{Tactics}

Basic Tactics does not allow repositioning of troops before combat, but instead increases the Speed of all your troops by +1.

advanced.description:
{Tactics}

Advanced Tactics does not allow repositioning of troops before combat, but instead increases the Speed of all your troops by +2.

expert.description:
{Tactics}

Expert Tactics does not allow repositioning of troops before combat, but instead increases the Speed of all your troops by +3.
